01.reason: The Roman and the pomegranates is complete in the one segment; what follows returns to the mishna.

02.reason: The Jew and the gentile on the road is complete in its segment; the surrounding text is the dispute about groaning and the mishna on men of leisure.

03.reason: The two linked strength incidents of Rabbi Abbahu and Rabbi Yohanan are told whole in one segment; the neighbouring segments are legal discussion.

04.reason: Rabbi Hananya ben Hakhinai's departure, return and his wife's revival run exactly segments 5-6; the next segment is a separate site story.

05.reason: Rabbi Hama bar Bisa's return and his son Rabbi Oshaya are told in 5-6; the closing verse comment is in the same segment as the story's end.

06.reason: The Rabbi Akiva and ben Kalba Savua story runs 5-7 from start to the father's reconciliation; the ben Azzai coda shares the last segment.

07.reason: Rav Rehumi's story is complete in its one segment, with the halakhic discussion before and a separate site story after.

08.reason: Yehuda son of Rabbi Hiyya's story is complete in its segment; neighbours are discussion or other site stories.

09.reason: Rabbi's son's two matches, his twelve years of study and his wife's cure run 5-8; the verse proof in 7 is part of Rabbi's words within the story.

10.reason: Rav Yosef son of Rava and the Yom Kippur eve confrontation is complete in its segment; the mishna on the rebellious wife follows.

11.reason: The case of Rav Zevid's daughter-in-law and Rav Gamda's rebuke runs 5-6; the summary ruling shares the last segment and what follows is legal discussion.

12.reason: Homa before Rava and the daughter of Rav Hisda driving her out runs 5-6; the next segment is a separate case.

13.reason: Nakdimon's daughter and Rabban Yohanan ben Zakkai runs 5-10; the Gemara's aside on Nakdimon's charity sits inside it and Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Tzadok's eyewitness account of her closes it, before the dowry discussion.

14.reason: Mar Ukva and his wife in the furnace is complete in 5-6; the Gemara's explanation that follows is discussion and correctly left out.

15.reason: Mar Ukva's doubled gift to the pampered pauper is complete in its segment; his deathbed story after is a separate site story.

16.reason: Mar Ukva's deathbed charity is in one segment that also holds the one-fifth discussion, which cannot be cut out.

17.reason: Hillel running before the poor man is at the end of segment 5, which opens with the baraita and cannot be split; the Upper Galilee incident after it is separate.

18.reason: Rabbi Nehemya and the pauper who died of lentils is complete in its segment; Rava's story after it is a separate site story.

19.reason: The pauper before Rava and the arrival of Rava's sister run 5-6; the charity baraitot follow.

20.reason: The exchange of letters between Rav Anan and Rav Huna through Rav Sheshet to Mar Ukva runs 5-8; the marzeiha gloss shares the last segment and the verse derivations after it are discussion.
